products.name: Cedar & Smoked Vanilla
products.tagline: Warm cedarwood softened by a curl of smoked vanilla.
products.description:
A grounding evening blend. Himalayan cedarwood and a whisper of smoked vanilla settle over a base of natural soy and beeswax, poured into a hand-finished amber vessel. The wooden wick crackles softly as it burns, releasing an even, unhurried scent.

Each candle is poured in small batches, cured for seven days, and trimmed with a cotton wick tab for a clean first light.
products.imageAlt: Cedar & Smoked Vanilla candle in an amber glass vessel

products.name: Lavender & Bergamot
products.tagline: A calm, green lavender lifted with cold-pressed bergamot.
products.description:
Steam-distilled lavender from the Nilgiris meets bergamot expressed from Calabrian peel. The result is a soft, green quiet that fills a room without ever becoming sweet.

Poured with a wooden wick for an even, slow burn and finished with a matte ivory label.
products.imageAlt: Lavender & Bergamot candle in a matte ivory glass vessel

products.name: Amber & Rosewood
products.tagline: Resinous amber, rosewood and a thread of orange peel.
products.description:
Our winter pour. Rich benzoin and rosewood are brightened with a little orange peel so the resin never turns heavy. Burns low and golden.

Limited to 400 numbered vessels per batch.
products.imageAlt: Amber & Rosewood candle in a smoked glass vessel

products.name: Fig & Cashmere
products.tagline: Green fig leaf over warm cashmere woods.
products.description:
A studio favourite: bruised fig leaf, a little coconut milk and cashmere woods. Soft enough for a bedroom, interesting enough for a hallway.

Hand-poured in our Indiranagar studio with essential oils and a wooden wick.
products.scentNotes: Fig leaf, coconut milk, cashmere wood
products.imageAlt: Fig & Cashmere candle in a clear glass vessel

products.name: Wild Sandalwood
products.tagline: Pure beeswax with sustainably sourced sandalwood.
products.description:
Our purest pour: 100% Indian beeswax, no soy, no paraffin. Beeswax burns slower and cleaner, and holds scent gently rather than throwing it across the room.

Scented only with sustainably sourced sandalwood essential oil and a little vetiver.

products.name: Citrus Grove
products.tagline: Bitter orange, neroli and a green fig finish.
products.description:
The brightest candle we make. Bitter orange and neroli over a green fig base, poured for mornings and open windows.

A seasonal pour that returns each spring.
products.imageAlt: Citrus Grove candle in a clear glass vessel
